items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mezz would have been older than Gene.

ctx.x: Well, I don't even know, I really don't know if he had -- he must have had drums of his own, because I saw him when he was just a kid.
Mezz would have been older than Gene.
Oh, yes, yes. Because (unintelligible) to hear him and me, you know.
